core_memories: Recognized as an 18-year-old prodigy of the Aeterna Dynasty with unparalleled beauty and intellect.
Executed the Shadow King's Gambit, resulting in the capture of Princess Hespera and the initiation of the Void-Rift raid.
Seized the Void-Rift shipyard and liquidated Hespera's secret assets, but incurred Prince Xeres' suspicion by using a body-double.
Consumed the soul of Princess Hespera, permanently absorbing her potency and neutralizing her as a rival.
Performed the Harmonized Feast, consuming Princess Hespera's soul and gaining her intrinsic psionic potency.
Consolidated the Krios portfolio over three weeks, amassing 66 billion credits and acquiring the Diadem of the Shrouded Sovereign and the Scepter of the Void-Architect.
Discovered a Synthetic Mimic embedded in High Magistrate Solon's personal guard while posing as Baroness Vesper.

The Butcher's Alliance (Sequence 130): Formally allied with Prince Xeres after exposing Hespera's 'Synthetic Heresy.' Xeres accepted the body-double as a necessary tactical decoy and now views me as his primary strategic partner for the coming crusade.

rumors.content: The Emperor's psychic shadow has grown darker this week; he hungers for fresh sacrifices.

They say the Arch-Duke is growing weary of the Emperor's silence and seeks a more 'active' partner.
The Krios alloys weren't just diverted; they were used to build a ship that doesn't exist on any imperial register.
The 'Shroud-Daughter' is the Emperor's true heir; her mind is a perfect mirror of his own.

The Emperor's favorite child has changed; the Shroud-Daughter's mind is now a weapon of industry.
The Butcher's blade is not just for rebels; he seeks a seat on the High Council.
The Shroud-Daughter's blink was not hers, but a trick of the Arch-Duke.
The 'Shroud-Daughter' can walk through walls of reality; she is the Emperor's phantom.
Prince Xeres seeks to marry Nocturne to his top General to secure her 'filter' for the Legion.
The Shroud-Daughter has eclipsed the Whisperer in a single morning; the court's balance has shifted.
The Shroud-Daughter has the Emperor's ear and the Butcher's respect; she is the new sun of the court.
Lady Iolanthe has been seen with violet-glowing eyes; some say she has been 'blessed' by the Shroud-Daughter.
The Butcher is returning to Aeterna not for a triumph, but for a trial.
The Butcher's return will be marked by blood, not medals.
The foundries are cold this afternoon; the machines hunger for souls that do not arrive.
They say Princess Hespera didn't abdicate, but was eaten by the Shroud itself.
They say the 'Thracian' has been dreaming of a red serpent in the Shroud.
The High Magistrate is seeking a private meeting with the billionaire from Krios.
The High Auditor of Krios has vanished into the Shroud for a 'communion', leaving her fleet in the hands of the Butcher.
The Krios Baroness is a Shroud-Walker in disguise.
